item.title: ‘Artificial’ Trailer: Andrew Garfield Stars As OpenAI CEO Sam Altman In Luca Guadagnino’s Silicon Valley Drama
item.description: How do you get fired from the company you helped build, only to return five days later with more power than ever? That’s the extraordinary corporate drama at the center of Luca Guadagnino ’s “ Artificial ,” a darkly comic account of the 2023 OpenAI boardroom coup that briefly ousted CEO Sam Altman before an employee revolt and investor pressure helped engineer his return. Andrew Garfield plays Altman in the film, which NEON is bringing to theaters this Christmas, and a new trailer offers a look at one of Silicon Valley’s strangest power struggles. item.title: 'Burial Hill': Vin Diesel's Next Feature Film Is An Amazon MGM Studios Action Pic From 'The Rip' Writer & 'Luther' Director
item.description: For the longest time, Vin Diesel has been pretty much churning out installments of " The Fast & The Furious " franchise with " Forever Fast ," the 11th film, on deck, but he's looking toward the future and has secured a lead part in an original action film at Amazon MGM Studios (becoming one of the more notable places for the action genre) called " Burial Hill ." As pointed out by the report from Deadline, the possible franchise-starter has a script penned by Mike McGrale ("The Following," "CSI: Miami"), who previously wrote films such as Ben Affleck / Matt Damon 's dirty cop thriller " The Rip " and Donnie Yen 's " John Wick " spinoff " Caine ." They've also enlisted director Jamie Payne , the helmer of Netflix ’s " Luther " movies starring Idris Elba and the original series.
